$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the customizations checklist settings; gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json. The checklist itself (its steps, what marks each done, n of m) is cmux-customize checklist.rs, answered by `cmux customize checklist`.

lists.name: customizeChecklist
lists.note: The customizations checklist (Leo 2026-11-22: "a customizations checklist. actually, this needs to be SOMEWHERE as a default. not just for me."): Settings > General's first card walks through making cmux your own, n of m done. cmux-customize checklist.rs reads these keys.

rows.name: enabled
rows.note: On by default for everyone. The card's Dismiss turns it off; this switch brings it back.

help.text: Shows the steps for making cmux your own at the top of Settings, with how many are done.

rows.name: done
rows.note: The ids of the checklist steps the person checked off by hand (cmux-customize checklist.rs STEPS); a step a setting or connection already marks is done without it. An id of a step since removed is ignored.

help.text: The checklist steps you marked done yourself.

rows.page_hidden: The checklist card checks steps off; the ids are not for typing.
